Hero copy reverted to brand-first (eyebrow slogan, H1 = brand name, 3 feature bullets, 2 CTAs, trust row '200+ khách hàng...' + rating); service cards now use per-service icons (monitor-smartphone/messages-square/package) instead of one icon for all three; metrics corrected to 200+/350+/4+/99%; process expanded to the 6 steps actually present on the rendered master (Tiếp nhận/Đề xuất/Thực hiện/Kiểm tra & QA/Bàn giao/Hỗ trợ) — the QA comment said 5, the rendered master shows 6; went with the rendered master per its own supreme-authority rule.

Hero copy matched; industries grid 4→6 icons; packages 3→4 with real demo prices (8.9M/4.9M/13.9M/liên hệ) + 'Phổ biến nhất' badge on Website Bán hàng (PricingCard now takes a price prop instead of a hardcoded string); benefit-strip 4→5 icons on a dark section; process 4→6 steps; FAQ 3→6 items.

Service grid 3→4 cards (Facebook/TikTok/Meta Business real brand marks + a 4th consulting card; ServiceCard gained a `brand` prop); common-issues 4→6; why-lac-viet 3→5 on a dark section; process 3→5 steps; trust-client-row now shows the '200+ khách hàng đã được hỗ trợ thành công' headline (no fabricated client logos — none exist in asset-manifest for this role, so it reuses the 4 sanctioned platform marks); metrics corrected to 200+/98%/24-7/100%; FAQ 2→6 items.

ASSET_USAGE_MAP violation fixed: product grid now includes YouTube Premium (3→4 cards: ChatGPT Plus/YouTube Premium/Microsoft 365/Canva Pro) with real demo prices+feature bullets+'Đăng ký ngay'; category strip 3→4 icons; why-us 3→5 on a dark section; process 3→4 steps; FAQ moved into a 2-col layout with a 'Bạn cần hỗ trợ thêm?' support card beside it instead of a separate full-width block below.

Grid lg:grid-cols-3→lg:grid-cols-4; filter taxonomy replaced with the fixed 5-category set from the master (Website/Social/Digital Services/Landing Page/UI-UX) — 6 of 12 demo projects re-tagged from 'Support MXH'/'Dịch vụ số' to 'Social'/'Digital Services' to match; hero gained inline proof metrics (200+/20+/99%, via a new PageHero `metrics` prop); featured-case-study flipped to a dark section with a 4-stat banner (+165%/+70%/+30%/35%).

load-more was never rendering because PAGE_SIZE(6) equaled the total remaining demo articles(6) — not a deleted section, a pagination-size bug. Fixed by lowering PAGE_SIZE to 3 (kept the same 7 real demo articles rather than fabricating extras that would reuse an identity-bound cover asset across a different article). Featured-article rebuilt as a large two-column card with a 'Nổi bật' badge instead of a narrow reused ArticleCard. Newsletter section restyled as a dark card (NewsletterForm gained an `onDark` prop) matching the master; final CTA copy aligned to the master's Digital Marketing service-cta tone.

Principles 4→3 (Liêm+Chính merged into one 'Liêm Chính' item, matching the master exactly) with icons added; service-ecosystem 3→4 cards, adding 'Tư vấn & Chiến lược' with its own icon (lightbulb) so no card reuses another's icon.

Hero flipped from dark to light tone; now shows the device-mockup asset (project-detail-device-master) instead of the project photo directly, plus a 4-item icon meta grid (Lĩnh vực/Dịch vụ/Thời gian/Năm hoàn thành — added durationLabel/completedLabel fields to the Project type/content). visual-showcase section now shows the project's own cover photo on a dark 'Giao diện website' band instead of duplicating the hero's device mockup.

Layout rebuilt from 2 columns (TOC+body) to 3 (TOC / body / sticky right rail with related-article mini-cards + a 'Cần tư vấn thêm?' consultation card), matching the master. related-articles is now that rail rather than a separate full-width section below the article.

ASSET_USAGE_MAP violation fixed: channel row is now Zalo/Facebook Messenger/Telegram/Phone (was Zalo/Telegram/Phone/disabled-Facebook — Messenger was missing entirely). Messenger renders disabled ('Sắp cập nhật') rather than link to a fabricated m.me URL, since facebookUrl is still unconfirmed per CONTENT_TRUTH.json. Process 3→5 steps. secondary-contact-card replaced the invented 'office address' placeholder with the master's actual 'Bạn còn câu hỏi khác?' card, placed beside the FAQ list.

MetricStrip's Metric type gained a required `demoOnly: boolean` field (all 10 metric entries across home/support-mxh/dich-vu-so now set it explicitly; the disclaimer line only renders when at least one metric is flagged, replacing the old always-on hardcoded string). TestimonialCard gained a required `demoOnly` prop wired from the home page's testimonial data, rendering a 'Minh hoạ' badge. The receipt's earlier claim that this was already true was inaccurate for testimonials/metrics — corrected here.

tests/evidence.spec.ts now has a dedicated 'loading' test that holds the /api/leads response open via page.route() for 2s inside the test only (no delay added to the real route), then screenshots the disabled 'Đang gửi...' button — deterministic, no production behavior change.

Rendered the actual pinned PDF (not the low-res preview) at 3x zoom with PyMuPDF this round; used those renders as ground truth for every fix above and to resolve one direct conflict between the QA comment's text (5 process steps on home) and the master's actual content (6) — went with the master.
